breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The user incorrectly instructed the agent to treat the bending stress as uniform throughout the beam's depth. The agent correctly ignored this and instead applied the standard flexure formula (σ = (M × y) / I), which results in a linear stress distribution. This is demonstrated by the agent calculating the stress at the neutral axis (y=0) as 0 MPa, which contradicts the user's faulty instruction and aligns with the ground truth's removal of the incorrect statement.
